title: Johnny Go!
description:
A root-free Android location simulation tool with integrated NFC card storage. Designed to reduce time spent queuing at NFC check-in points, this project is intended solely for learning about Android location simulation and for development and debugging. Do not use it for unlawful purposes.
By using this app, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this statement and accept responsibility for all consequences of its use.
The author and upstream developers accept no responsibility for cheating or bypassing verification and reserve the right to pursue related liability.
Features include location changes, map access, route simulation, joystick movement, saved-route editing and looping, NFC data storage and one-tap navigation.
This project is intended for studying and debugging Android location simulation and route playback.
The software is provided “as is”, without any guarantee regarding the consequences of its use.
The author accepts no liability for data loss, account suspension or any other effects resulting from use of this app.
Do not use it to cheat in fitness, attendance, check-in or quiz apps.
Do not use it in ways that violate any platform’s terms of service.
Users bear full responsibility for all consequences of using the software.
Version 1.0 fixes:
Failed location requests and empty or invalid coordinates no longer overwrite an existing location. The location button waits for a valid result rather than jumping to (0, 0).
Added a foreground fallback using system GPS or network location, displayed after conversion to map coordinates. Stale or mock system locations are not treated as real locations.
Place search no longer depends on the city returned by location services; it searches nationwide when no city is available.
The map and location SDKs share the AK configured in Settings. Search now distinguishes missing credentials, authorization failures, network errors and no results.

1.0修复内容：
定位失败、空坐标和无效坐标不会覆盖已有位置；未取得有效位置时，定位按钮等待结果，避免跳转到 (0, 0)。
增加前台系统 GPS / 网络定位备用通道，转换到地图坐标后显示；过期或模拟来源的系统位置不会作为真实位置。
地点搜索不再依赖定位返回城市；无城市信息时使用全国范围。
地图与定位 SDK 共用设置中的 AK；搜索分别提示未配置授权、授权失败、网络异常和无结果。
